glosses: To place excessive emphasis on something.
To place excessive physical stress on something, especially to such an extent that it deforms or breaks.

examples.text: [...] the complete frame will withstand a standing and buffing load of 200 tons without overstressing.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: in zu hohem Maße beanspruchen und dadurch meist schädigen

glosses: To subject to an excessive demand on strength, resources, abilities, or the imagination.

examples.text: The very phrase of "generous forbearance" shocked her as overstrained; but she did marvel that Lord Avonleigh felt neither pained nor embarrassed in a situation where such sensations seemed inevitable.
Clover warned him sometimes to be careful not to overstrain himself, but Boxer would never listen to her.
